name: GlobalModify
caption: When a record is modified

configuration.description: Table whose modifications start the flow. Stored on the trigger registration at publish; 0 means the flow never fires.

Field filters the modified record (after-image) must match: [{ "fieldNo": <integer>, "filter": "<BC filter expression>" }]. Applied literally (max 250 chars, placeholders not resolved). Rows with fieldNo 0 are skipped; duplicate fieldNo: last wins.

Fields to watch: [{ "fieldNo": <integer> }]. When non-empty the flow fires only if at least one watched field differs from AutoFlow's stored snapshot. Empty = fire on every modify that passes the filters. fieldNo 0 and duplicates are ignored.

outputs.name: Rec
outputs.when: always; type 'reference' with tableNo = configuration.tableNo when tableNo > 0, otherwise declared as type 'value'

outputs.name: ChangedFields
outputs.when: always; JSON array text [{"fieldNo":int,"fieldName":text,"oldValue":text,"newValue":text}] of the watched fields that changed, '[]' when no watch fields are configured

rules.check: configuration.tableNo must be present and > 0 (editor ValidateConfiguration returns false otherwise). Not checked at publish: a flow without a table publishes and never fires.
configuration.filters, if present, must be an array.
configuration.watchFields, if present, must be an array.
An invalid filter expression makes the record count as not matching; the user's modify is never blocked.

notes: Fires on every modify of the table in any session, as long as the modify reaches Business Central's global database events.

Execution is asynchronous: the modify creates a pending execution inside the modifying transaction; a recurring Job Queue entry (every 5 minutes, created on publish) queues one Job Queue run per pending execution. Runs commit after every step.

Watch-field change detection compares against a snapshot table, not against xRec: values are formatted locale-invariantly and compared by SHA-256 hash. The snapshot is filled for all existing records when a version with watch fields is published, refreshed on every insert/modify of the table and removed on delete. The snapshot is shared per table and field across all GlobalModify flows on that table.
If no snapshot row exists for a record/field (e.g. inserted while no watch-field flow was published), oldValue is '' and any non-empty current value counts as a change.
ChangedFields oldValue/newValue are XML-formatted (locale-invariant) text, truncated to 2048 characters each.
Step-level rule imposed by this trigger: a Confirm dialog step gets the publish warning that it runs inside the record change that started the flow.
Picker filters: Respond to Webhook, Return SubFlow Output, Return PDF, Set report file name, Set document field values and Prevent page close are hidden.
A flow that modifies the same table again (e.g. a Modify Record step) triggers itself again when the write runs triggers; use filters or watch fields to avoid loops.
